negative_reviews.author: スペースoppaikunt
negative_reviews.text: Waited at least 20 minutes for a server, couple next to us didn’t get their second main until after their first meal. Server didn’t come back to us again until around 20 minutes after we finished our main for our pre-ordered dessert. Forgot spoons as well for dessert. Food was good, nothing crazy of course. Broth was very well done and rich, but the pork slices were tough and only got two for a large portion.

negative_reviews.author: Mai
negative_reviews.text:
Disappointing experience - had to wait for ages, my bowl of ramen was cold when it was finally served, didn't even get my water. People next to me were only served half of the dishes they ordered and even though they asked a few times, it never came, making them cancel their order in the end. I came here because of the positive reviews for the vegan ramen but the experience was not worth it (ramen were also just ok and, as said above, cold).

Sidenote: The state of the toilets was really awful

negative_reviews.author: Ruth Ashley
negative_reviews.text: Great food and great service from staff but the condition of the restaurant really lets this place down. i’m a huge fan of maki and ramen in edinburgh and was excited that they’re in london now but this particular restaurant had a very strong smell of damp, and the toilets were in terrible condition. i’m really hoping these were just temporary problems but we felt the setting was just a bit run down to be a nice place to eat.

negative_reviews.author: Tierdish
negative_reviews.text:
Rude waitress but very good ramen. She made a weird face and laughed at us when we asked if we could put a food item on the side due to our friends dietary requirements.
We did feel quite uncomfortable and weirded out by this.
The food itself was good but this was very strange

deliveroo.source: sales + orders: Deliveroo Tax Invoice PDF (Total Order Value), issued 02/11/2026 + ops from Weekly Summary sheet

issues: Soho grossed £56.52K last week with labour at 23.42% (Admin Meeting 02/11).
Michael Salvador said Soho is very close to signing off after about £50K last week, and Sophie Wang said she can see the site improving a lot (Ops meeting 03/11).
Michael Salvador said the Soho team is actively using the dashboard (Ops meeting 03/11).

Remy Eutrope is finalising the Soho kitchen operations plan, which will be based from upstairs, and needs to review the basic equipment and brief the team on the new workflow while keeping walkie talkie communication with downstairs (Admin Meeting 02/11).
Google Ads: Soho was one of the venues that saw losses last week while Southampton grew (DPM meeting 03/11).
Sales exceeded £50,000 (£50.5K, £8.6K over target), with delivery sales up 29% to about £2K and covers up 12% (London KPI meeting 03/11 and AM Updates 04/11).
Food cost was 24%, under the 25% threshold, and spend per head was £19.29 because of promotional pricing such as £5 ramen (London KPI meeting 03/11).
Food variance was about 11% (11.6%), which the site put down to system issues or frozen product weights discussed with Remy and Marian (London KPI meeting 03/11 and AM Updates 04/11).

Ramen chefs were batching tickets (up to 12 ramens at once), causing 30 to 40 minute waits at peak, and Kaitlin Docherty reorganised the kitchen workflow, cutting peak ticket times to 13 minutes (London KPI meeting 03/11).
Reviews: 26 five star alongside several lower ratings about service delays and inattentive service at peak (London KPI meeting 03/11).
Customers complained about a strong damp smell and poor toilet conditions, which Ziang Lin said will improve with the upcoming construction work (London KPI meeting 03/11).

Weekday lunches are quiet against packed evenings, so labour is being adjusted, including sending staff home early on Sunday, and Ziang Lin asked for the labour percentage to come down (London KPI meeting 03/11 and AM Updates 04/11).
The site struggled with ordering schedules and preventing ramen shortages, and yakisoba and sushi preparation is causing workflow delays (AM Updates 04/11).
Christmas: a 56 person group and a 20 person university society are booked for December pending the final Christmas menu, and deposits will be required (London KPI meeting 03/11).
actions: Review the basic equipment needed for the upstairs kitchen and brief the team on the new workflow - Owner: Remy Eutrope (10/11/2026)
Pull the Soho variance report for the next review - Owner: Ziang Lin (10/11/2026)
Agree a fix for BOH speed and kitchen communication with Remy and report back - Owner: Kaitlin Docherty (10/11/2026)
Push for Google reviews during quiet periods - Owner: Kaitlin Docherty (10/11/2026)
Collect deposits from large Christmas group bookings - Owner: Kaitlin Docherty (10/11/2026)
Develop a solution with Marian for kitchen efficiency and food quality delays - Owner: Remy Eutrope (10/11/2026)
